personas.title: Critical Live-Client Regressions (Skills, PLEX Store, Warp Animation, Slash, Quasar)
personas.description: Immediately exercise the highest-risk live V24.01 UI flows that broke during manual playtesting: (1) Open Character Sheet & Skill Plans panel, prime personal plans, buy/inject a skillbook, and start/pause/reorder live skill training queue; (2) Open PLEX Vault & New Eden Store (aurumStoreView), verify Quasar BalanceRequest succeeds without TimeoutException, and test free PLEX pack & NES SKIN purchase; (3) Execute slash commands (/help, /, /giveskill, /heal) verifying FetchRemoteCommandList and SlashError reason dict; (4) Undock into space, initiate a real-time warp (WITHOUT skipping 240s of clock), capture 4 burst frames, and verify both Destiny ball.mode==3 (WARP), fxSequencer 'effects.Warping', warp_signals, and visible warp tunnel animation.

personas.title: Newbro Progression, Fitting, Inventory & Station Services
personas.description: Explore station hangar views, Inventory window (stack splitting, moving items between hangar and cargo), Ship Fitting window (online/offline/fit/unfit modules, verify CPU/PG and Dogma attributes update), Medical clone / home station, Repair shop, Insurance, and AIR Career Program / Daily Goals.

personas.title: In-Space Navigation, Destiny Physics, Combat, Drones & EWAR
personas.description: Undock, test sub-warp navigation (Approach, Orbit, Keep at Range, Align, Stop), real-time Warp to celestials/belts/anomalies with burst screenshots, Stargate jump transitions, Target Locking, Weapon & EWAR module activation/cycling, Drone launch/engage/return, overview & D-Scan, probe scanner, and bookmark creation.

personas.title: Market, Contracts, Wallet, Industry & Reprocessing
personas.description: Open Regional Market (browse categories, view price history & orders, place buy/sell orders, modify/cancel orders), Wallet (ISK & PLEX transactions, journal, shares), Contracts (create/search/accept item exchange, auction, courier), Industry window (manufacturing, research, invention), and Reprocessing plant.

personas.title: Corporation, Fleet, Upwell Structures, SKINR & Agency
personas.description: Open Corporation window (roles, wallets, bulletins, applications, corporation goals via Quasar), Fleet Finder & Fleet broadcasts/wings, Structure Browser & Upwell docking/tethering/Cosmetics (structureCosmeticStatesController), Paragon Hub / SKINR studio, Agency (encounters, incursions, insurgency, FW, homefront, exploration), and Mail/Calendar/Chat.

personas.title: Adversarial UI Chaos & Multi-Window Stress Test
personas.description: Rapidly open/switch tabs across every Neocom window, right-click context menus on ships/items/celestials/characters, test invalid inputs, edge-case slash commands, rapid dock/undock, and mid-warp sub-warp commands.

initial_frontier.title: Skill Sheet, Skill Injection & Live Training Queue Start/Apply
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Character Sheet -> Skills, inject/purchase skill if needed, add skill level to training queue, verify skillMgr2 / skillQueue RPCs succeed, OnSkillStarted / OnServerSkillsChanged fire, and active training progress renders with zero exceptions.

initial_frontier.title: Skill Plans Browser & Personal Plans Quasar Cache (#528)
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Skill Plans window (personalPlansPanel / skillPlanService.GetAllPersonal), verify _PrimePersonalCache completes without SkillPlansErrorTimeout / SkillPlanConnectionError, and create/delete a personal skill plan.

initial_frontier.title: New Eden Store / PLEX Balance Quasar Request & FastCheckout (#529)
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open New Eden Store (aurumStoreView.SetupStoreData) and PLEX Vault, verify eve_public.plex.vault.api.BalanceRequest succeeds without TimeoutException, browse offers, and redeem/buy an offer.

initial_frontier.title: Devtools Slash Service FetchRemoteCommandList & Error Dict (#530)
initial_frontier.acceptance: Invoke svc_slash.FetchRemoteCommandList / SlashCmd('/') and valid/invalid slash commands; verify no KeyError: 'reason' is raised.

initial_frontier.title: Real-Time In-Space Warp Tunnel Animation & Destiny Mode 3 (#531)
initial_frontier.acceptance: Undock and initiate warp to a celestial/planet at >150km WITHOUT instant clock-skipping; capture burst screenshots and verify ego ball reaches mode=3 (WARP), fxSequencer activates 'effects.Warping', warp speed indicator animates, and ship decelerates smoothly at destination.

initial_frontier.title: Structure Cosmetics Quasar get_all_in_solar_system_request (#527)
initial_frontier.acceptance: In space, verify structureCosmeticStatesController._get_all_in_solar_system completes via publicGatewaySvc without TimeoutException.

initial_frontier.title: Inventory Window, Stack Split & Cargo Transfer
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Inventory window, list ship cargo and item hangar, split an item stack, and move items between hangar and active ship.

initial_frontier.title: Fitting Window, Module Equip, Online/Offline & Dogma Stats
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Fitting window, fit or toggle a module online/offline, verify Dogma CPU/powergrid and ship attributes update.

initial_frontier.title: In-Space Target Lock, Module Activation & Drone Control
initial_frontier.acceptance: In space, lock a target (NPC or structure/asteroid), activate a module/weapon, and verify OnGodmaShipEffect / damage or mining cycle.

initial_frontier.title: Stargate Jump Session Change & Station Docking
initial_frontier.acceptance: Warp to a stargate, jump to adjacent solar system, verify session change and ballpark re-bind, then warp to station and dock.

initial_frontier.title: Regional Market Window, Price History & Order Placement
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Regional Market, inspect item orders and price history, place a buy or sell order, and verify wallet & order book update.

initial_frontier.title: Contracts Window Search & Creation
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Contracts window, search available contracts, and create or inspect an item exchange contract.

initial_frontier.title: Industry Window & Reprocessing
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Industry window, inspect blueprints/facilities, and verify job preview or submission.

initial_frontier.title: Corporation Window & Quasar Corporation Goals
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open Corporation window and Goals tab, verifying get_unclaimed_goal_ids / Quasar goalMessenger responds without timeout.

initial_frontier.title: The Agency, Opportunities & AIR Daily Goals
initial_frontier.acceptance: Open The Agency / Opportunities window, switch tabs (Encounters, Exploration, Resource Harvesting, Daily Goals), verify zero exceptions.
